task.question: On what date did resident doctors in England announce a four-day strike in June 2026?
task.evidence: Resident doctors in England announce a four-day strike from 7am on 15 June, their 16th strike action over a pay dispute.

answer:
The resident doctors in England announced a four-day strike starting from 7am on 15 June 2026. 

FINAL: 15 June 2026

messages.content: You solve tasks. If you need to calculate or look up a fact, call tools instead of guessing. When the answer is ready, write it as the last line in the format FINAL: <answer>. For numeric tasks put only the number after FINAL, for factual questions a short phrase.
On what date did resident doctors in England announce a four-day strike in June 2026?
[2026 in England] Events of the year 2026 in England.

[2026 in England]
Resident doctors in England vote in favour of further strike action in their long-running dispute with the UK government over pay and training posts.
The British Medical Association announces that resident doctors in England will stage a six-day strike from 7am on 7 April after talks between union representatives and the UK government broke down.
Resident doctors in England begin a six-day strike
Resident doctors announce a four-day strike from 7am on 15 June, their 16th strike action over a pay dispute.

The resident doctors in England announced a four-day strike starting from 7am on 15 June 2026. 

FINAL: 15 June 2026
